help:
NeoHaskell native installer

This build provides help and version only. Lifecycle operations are not available in this build.

Usage:
  neo-installer [--help | --version]

Options:
  -h, --help       Show this help.
  -V, --version    Show the product and build identity.
invalid_arguments: This build supports only --help and --version. Run neo-installer --help for details.
